# Sham Tours

> Sham Tours (شام تورز) — Official online travel agency for tourist packages, Umrah trips, custom itineraries, and visa applications.

## Main Services & Booking

- [Official Platform](https://shamtours.am8ed.site): Main online booking portal for tourist packages and Umrah schedules.
- [Custom Trip Planner](https://shamtours.am8ed.site/#planner): Interactive custom itinerary generator for individuals and families.
- [Visa Services](https://shamtours.am8ed.site/#visa): Tourist and transit visa issuance and application processing.

## Contact & Customer Desk

- [WhatsApp Desk](https://wa.me/201019688320): Instant WhatsApp support for reservations and inquiries.
- [Main Portfolio](https://am8ed.site): Developer portfolio of Amged Sayed.
